text:
maria: kicking off config-only deploy now — reducing batch_window_ms: 20 -> 8, per_tenant_qps: 20 -> 12, routing policy = prefer-small-batches. Canary 3% for 15m. deploy-bot queued.
deploy-bot: Canary started (cfg-canary-1717205432) — routing weight=3%, batch_window_ms=8, pinned_model=v2.1.3. Health checks enabled.
jake: ack. I'll watch p50/p95 and queue depth dashboards.
nina: noted pin to v2.1.3. adding a quick eval set for the canary.
ops-oncall: seeing baseline — small blip in p95 on a couple of edges but nothing sustained yet.
maria: good. alert threshold: rollback if canary p95 > 300ms for 5m or error rate +0.5%.
(6m later)
jake: heads up — p95 jumped to ~420ms for a subset of tenants (high-kv lookups). tail increase aligns with kvcache misses.
nina: can we cut routing weight or increase batch window? If kvcache pressure is the cause, tiny batches hurt.
maria: hold the main ramp. reduce canary weight to 1%, set batch_window_ms back to 12, keep pinned_model v2.1.3. I'm opening a follow-up ticket.
deploy-bot: Updating canary weight -> 1% ... done. batch_window_ms -> 12 ... done. health checks unchanged.
ops-oncall: confirm — dashboards show immediate improvement on canary nodes, p95 trending down.
jake: putting a temporary fallback for affected tenants to v2.0.9 (safer kv behavior) — will only route tenants with tail>400ms. Command I ran:
```
/deploy fallback --canary cfg-canary-1717205432 --from v2.1.3 --to v2.0.9 --selector "tail>400ms"
```
nina: thanks. good surgical fallback. please document tenant list in the ticket.
maria: ticket TKT-23456 created: "kvcache pressure during small-batch canary — followup and tuning". assigning to eng-runtime.
(10m later)
jake: canary p95 now ~260ms, error rate normal. fallback routed ~0.7% of traffic.
nina: running a quick eval on the canary outputs — quality looks identical. no regressions.
maria: plan: hold at 1% for 15m, then staged ramp to 10% over 30m if stable. notify if p95 > 300ms.
ops-oncall: will watch. setting temporary alert with 3-min cadence.
jake: +1. Adding blameless note to release notes: "config-only: adjusted batching and per-tenant qps; introduced temporary fallback for high-tail tenants; followup ticket TKT-23456."
maria: adding final ops note in release channel. Great coordination — :thumbsup:. Closing thread when ramp completes.
(18m later)
nina: after staged ramp to 10% p95 remains stable ~240ms. no further action.
maria: closing out — leaving follow-up to eng-runtime for kvcache tuning (assigned). Marking rollout as success. :white_check_mark:
